prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a professional painted character model sheet for a contemporary literary political thriller.
Primary request: one clean, beautiful model sheet on uniform neutral warm-gray paper, with exactly nine coherent views of the SAME person. Arrange four bust/head turnarounds across the top: front, three-quarter, side profile, rear head; two complete full-body views at lower left: front and back, ordinary neutral standing posture; three restrained expression busts at lower right. Balanced spacing, easy to inspect, elegant studio character design sheet, 16:10 landscape canvas. All views share exactly the same face, natural body proportions, hair, clothing, colors and age.
Style/medium: beautiful painted realism, cinematic gouache/oil with visible thick brushwork, matte paper and paint texture, warm charcoal, slate and muted amber, sober human characterization. Same cast-art medium as reference. Anatomically believable, no fashion glamour, heroic poses, cartoon or anime.
Lighting: soft even studio illumination, readable features, warm-gray ground without scenic backgrounds.
Constraints: no biographical claims, story details, badges with text, logos, watermark, decorative borders, website or UI. The sheet name and view/expression labels are the only permitted words.
Input image: reference for Adrian's approved rear silhouette, dark wavy hair and charcoal knit sweater ONLY; do not copy room furniture or television.
Subject: Adrian Marsh, male university professor. Create a provisional front-facing design compatible with the adult rear figure in the reference: mid-to-late forties, thoughtful gently lined face, medium warm complexion, average lean build, dark short wavy hair with a very small gray touch at the temples, thin metal spectacles, charcoal knitted crewneck sweater, sober dark trousers and ordinary dark shoes. Eyewear stays consistent in every angle. Natural expressive eyes, composed intelligent presence, neither celebrity likeness nor archetypal action hero.
Expressions: calm inquiry, quiet unease, restrained resolve. Expression changes subtle, same facial structure in all views.
Text allowed: title "ADRIAN MARSH"; very small clean view labels "FRONT", "THREE-QUARTER", "PROFILE", "REAR", "FULL FRONT", "FULL BACK", "CALM INQUIRY", "UNEASE", "RESOLVE". No other wording.
Priorities: make the full-body rear figure, haircut and knit sweater recognizably the same silhouette as the approved living-room painting; stable new face is a provisional v1 casting choice.
